name: Shimmer Wing
look: a shaggy crouching scarlet dinosaur-bird with a curling gold crest, a lime tuft, dark blue claws, a skirt of lime-to-white tail feathers and a long tail ending in a golden brush
entry: A Pokémon resembling Ho-Oh, described in an old book of legends about a rainbow-feathered beast that strutted through blossoming groves. Its plumage shimmers in seven colours in the sun.
how: Wild: very rare by day in cherry groves, flower forests and sunflower plains.
